notes.title: Misao - 2024 HD Remaster Update!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26245179/72cf31a1db9355778adf1d35b7614444c574c8bf.png[/img]

Mad Father developer sen's other horror classic Misao: Definitive Edition was released 7 years ago in October 2017, and today, it has been reborn again into Misao - 2024 HD REmaster!

Misao - 2024 HD Remaster doesn't only add HD graphics and update the overall presentation, but also adds new features that make exploring stages all the more enjoyable, giving the game a new playfeel.

If you've already witnessed all the horrors of Misao, get the update now to see a newly reborn Misao.

...Did you know that Misao has a surprising thing in common with Mad Father, despite the difference in setting. If you haven't yet, why not try to find the link?

Owners of Mad Father can get Misao - 2024 HD Remaster in the Blood-Soaked Bundle for 10% off!

https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/5052/

notes.title: Mad Father Remake, Now Available on Steam!
notes.content:
Dear fans,

Finally, the Mad Father Remake has been released! If you already own the original on Steam it will be updated free of charge.

Remake version features below.

[h2]Changes[/h2]

[h3]New Elements[/h3]

[list]
[*] Updated graphics (characters/maps/some skills/etc.)
[*] Widened game screen
[*] New events
[*] Newly added/revamped systems
[*] Newly added second playthrough “Blood Mode” (greatly changes the main scenario)
[*] New maps
[*] Gamepad compatibility
[*] Noise filter feature (can be turned off in Settings)
[*] “Doll Maker” added to Museum
[*] New menu screens (Missions, Help, Options)
[*] Newly added controller button allocation feature
[*] Newly added voices (new variations incl. father’s laugh, etc.)
[/list]

[h3]New Episodes[/h3]
[list]
[*] Memories of the origins of the relationship between the Blonde-Haired Youth & the Drevis family
[*] In Blood Mode: Revelations of Aya’s mother and Drevis family secrets
[*] In Blood Mode: Play as a new main character and trace the history of the cursed Drevis clan
[/list]

[h2]Special campaign commemorating the release of the Mad Father remake![/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26245179/f446bc4acbf8faf6537608116701dc831defadf0.png[/img]

We’d like all the Mad Father fans throughout the world to join us in livening up the remade version release! Follow us on Twitter at [b]@playismEN[/b] and tweet your fan art, cosplay photos, or opinions on the game with the hashtag [b]#MadFather[/b] by November 12th! Both new and previously posted items are acceptable. We’ll select 20 participants to receive special tin badges with original illustrations of Aya by the developer, sen!
(*Only applicable to those in regions to which the badges can be shipped.)

We hope you all enjoy this fantastic remake of the classic Mad Father.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/483980/Mad_Father/

notes.title: Ver 3.04 Updated
notes.content:
Hi all,

We finally updated the main build to ver3.04.
In the last update, many of you had crush errors, so we reverted the system back to the point when we had the least number of problems.

If any of you have their issues solved, still there, or got new issues, etc.. please let us know as a reply to this news.
Information like crush report/ system environment / OS version will be a big help.

Ver3.01 -> Ver3.04
Update:
[list]
[*]Added a reset function - F6 key
[*]Prologue skip feature added
[*]The gimick for the diner is modified
[*]SE volume optimized
[/list]

Bug fix:
[list]
[*]Chainsaw disabled after using the warp near the end of the game.
[*]Command action didn't display any keys and couldn't escape from the attack
-> Directional keys seem to be the issue. Now it is shown with abcd keys.
[*]The map chip of the pew where Ogre is sitting had wrong colour.
[*]Small map fix
[*]Font fix: new fonts implemented for the better visual.
[/list]

notes.title: Mad Father Out Now!
notes.content:
We are super excited to announce that Mad Father is out now! 

[img=https://s3-ap-northeast-1.amazonaws.com/images.playism-games.com/game_slide_fullsize/media/1c292446494ed966c68343a4b5acf2fd.png]

On the eve of the anniversary of her mother’s death, Aya reminisces about the past. With the desire to celebrate with her father, Aya asks her father who readily agrees before sending her to bed. But the hope is quickly shattered when her father’s scream shakes Aya from her sleep. Aya dashes out in hopes to find her father, only to find her house littered with corpses and other horrors. Will the dead engulf Aya? Will she escape with the manor’s assistant, Maria? Or will she save her father from the unknown horrors?

[b]Updates and Improvements[/b]
[list][*]Mad Father is a classic JRPG horror game which has finally been released on Playism and Steam. For this release, a number of things have been updated to the original free version:
[*]Improved map tiles
[*]Some of the art has been redrawn
[*]Some of the unique elements have been changed.
[*]Improved playability
1. If you stand next to an event, a question mark bubble will appear above the character.
2. Items will glitter to make them easier to spot.
[*]New events
1. Ines’ past revealed.
2. New dialogue.
[*]Some gems have been relocated.
[*]ATE mini games have changed from rapid input to command input.
[*]Some changes to the game’s music
1. New music inside the mansion.
2. Second floor basement music is changed.
[/list]

[i]Please note we are working on the Acheivements Bug, thank you for your understanding and patience![/i]

We hope you enjoy the game!
